title: fix: preserve unchanged key limits when saving edits
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: API key edits now save only changed fields, so an open editor cannot overwrite a newer budget, expiry, or permissions. Expiry displays as rounded days, but saving without changing it preserves the stored deadline. App-key edits no longer send hidden limits, and expired keys or spent budgets no longer block unrelated edits.
